purpose.zh: 练肩部和手臂后侧的推举力量
purpose.en: Build overhead pressing strength in the shoulders and triceps.

text.zh: 从耳朵高度向上推到手臂接近伸直
text.en: Press from ear height until your arms are almost straight overhead

text.zh: 肘在手腕正下方，略在身体前方
text.en: Keep your elbows under your wrists and slightly in front of your body.

text.zh: 肋骨下沉不后仰，慢慢放回
text.en: Keep your ribs down without leaning back, and lower slowly.

commonErrors.en: Arching the lower back to press.

cautions.zh: 从轻重量开始，出现疼痛就停止
cautions.en: Start with a light weight, and stop if you feel pain.

cautions.zh: 肩前侧夹痛时缩小幅度或换简单版本
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulder pinches, reduce the range or switch to an easier version.
